chunks: He said: He put on the woolen cloak and cut himself away from the world.

key_terms.الدُّنْيَا: The world, referring to temporal life and material attachments
key_terms.الْعَبَاءَة: Woolen cloak or mantle, symbolizing simplicity and asceticism

ai.seo_question: What does wearing the woolen cloak symbolize in Shia ethics?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Nahj al-Balagha*, the Prophet (or an Imam) dons the simple woolen cloak (*‘abāmah*) to visibly demonstrate *zuhd* (asceticism), contrasting spiritual wealth with material accumulation. This act serves as a practical lesson for his companion, emphasizing that true dignity lies in detachment from worldly luxuries rather than in the vastness of one's house or possessions.
